headline: A 2022 law renames a Postal Service building in Saint Clair, Michigan, after Corporal Jeffrey Robert Standfest.
what_it_does: This law officially names the United States Postal Service facility at 202 Trumbull Street in Saint Clair, Michigan, the Corporal Jeffrey Robert Standfest Post Office Building. It changes only the name of the building and does not change how the post office operates. It does not add or remove any services, fees, or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on June 16, 2022.
